notes: Device is the wall-mounted "2N SIP Speaker" (Black/White variant), a SIP/ONVIF-S based active IP speaker with an integrated 2x10W amplifier — distinct from the outdoor "2N SIP Speaker Horn" model. Physical connectors confirmed from the manufacturer's installation manual (2N_SIP_Speaker_Wall_Mounted_Manual_EN_2.10.pdf, wiki.2n.com), which lists "Connectors and Controls: LAN (10/100BASE-TX RJ-45), Speaker (amplifier output terminals), RESET button, DC IN (12V DC/2A adapter connector)" and shows a back-panel photo confirming the Speaker OUT and DC IN are 2-pin screw/captive terminal blocks (mapped here to euroblock / euroblock-dc, the closest connector-list matches — not true barrel jacks). Ethernet grade set to eth-100m because the spec explicitly states 10/100BASE-TX (Fast Ethernet, no Gigabit). No grade set on the audio or DC terminals per the schema rules. The manual's overview text also states the unit "is equipped with a digital input and output," but no such connector appears in the labeled back-panel diagram/photo (only LAN, Speaker OUT, RESET, DC IN are shown) — likely boilerplate text reused from another 2N intercom manual, so it was not included as a physical port. Not rack-mountable (wall-mount enclosure, 250x176x143mm).

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: RJ-45 on rear panel, 10/100BASE-TX with Auto-MDIX; also carries PoE IEEE 802.3af power to the unit (no separate PoE port).

ports.name: Speaker OUT
ports.note: 2-pin captive screw terminal from the integrated amplifier; wired to one 8Ω loudspeaker (12W, external 12V supply) or two 8Ω loudspeakers in parallel (2x9W).

ports.name: DC IN
ports.note: Labeled 'DC IN 12V 2A'; a 2-pin captive screw terminal (not a barrel jack) for the external 12V DC / 1.8-2A power adapter, used when PoE is not available.
